text: O magnify the LORD with me, And let us lift up His name together.
The angel of the LORD encamps around those who fear Him [with awe-inspired reverence and worship Him with obedience], And He rescues [each of] them.
Turn away from evil and do good; Seek peace and pursue it.
The LORD is near to the heartbroken And He saves those who are crushed in spirit (contrite in heart, truly sorry for their sin).
The LORD redeems the soul of His servants, And none of those who take refuge in Him will be condemned.
